title: PolicyChangedPayload
description: Payload of the PolicyChanged platform event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8, §28.18, §37; class: platform; FR-AH.15). Feeds the policy replica of every service (feeds_runtime_replicas: true) from the platform topic gst.platform.policy-changed.v1, which every service reads under its consumer SELECT grant (INV-REQ-1205, INV-Q-8998). Authored by INV-T-2855 (T11). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

scope.description: The scope the changed value applies to (tenant, entity or global, per the variation point's own reach).

vpId.description: The variation point identifier, e.g. 'VP-72' (catalogued as VariationPoint, STK-61).

value.description: The new value (opaque here; typed per variation point by its own reader, PolicyReader).

effectiveDate.description: The date this value takes effect.

source.description: Where the value came from (API-09 casing).

relaxationAcknowledgementReference.description: Reference to the relaxation acknowledgement this change required, present only when the change relaxes a control (controls tighten-only otherwise).
